orbis-compat is MIT-licensed, with ONE named exception. That file says so in its own header;
each file's SPDX-License-Identifier is authoritative for that file.

  include/sys/ioccom.h   BSD-3-Clause. Its macros follow FreeBSD's sys/sys/ioccom.h because they
                         describe an ABI this platform inherited; a re-implementation that differed
                         would be wrong rather than original.

⚠ cmake/orbis-tls.ld WAS the other exception and is no longer in this repository. It moved to
orbis-ports/orbis-porting-kit on 2026-09-18 with the rest of the CMake, and it is still
GPL-3.0-only there - a derivative of the OpenOrbis toolchain's own link.x, which grants no linking
exception. A bundle staging it into orbis-compat/cmake/ carries the kit's copy and the kit's
LICENSE covers it.
